children.name: Convert Jupyter Notebooks to MDX Documentation
children.description: Automated micro-skill to transform Jupyter notebooks into MDX-formatted documentation files. Handles frontmatter injection, GitHub link resolution, and conversion of pip install commands to CodeGroup format. Designed for batch processing example notebooks into a versioned documentation directory.
